Hold ONE large dark semi-automatic pistol with both hands near chest level aimed slightly toward the right; this is a new adaptation pose, do not reproduce the two-gun poster composition. Draw every limb and all fingers coherently, with separated forearms. Square canvas about 1024x1024 with generous clear margins above hair and outside both hands and feet; whole figure visible from hair to soles, feet about 92% of canvas height.
